long_description:
Stretch, breathe, cuddle—repeat. Join us for Paws & Pose: Rescue Puppy Yoga—a 60-minute slow-flow yoga class led by certified instructor Lisa Pickert from Yogaview, with some very special co-hosts: adoptable puppies from One Tail at a Time!

 You’ll move through a gentle and grounding practice while adorable pups roam the room offering cuddles, laughs, and the occasional kiss. After class, stick around to meet the pups, learn more about OTAT’s mission, and find out how you can get involved in the rescue community—or maybe you’ll fall in love and bring home a new puppy.

 Cost: $50 (includes yoga class, donation to OTAT, and puppy cuddles!).

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Chicago, Workshops in Chicago.
